home.tagline: A full-stack Vue meta-framework built on Vite, Hono and Vue.

ssr.title: Full-stack SSR
ssr.desc: Vue SSR with Inertia-style page routing, islands architecture, and view transitions. Per-route SSR control and streaming support for fast TTFB.

routing.title: File-based Routing
routing.desc: Typed API + page routes, defineHandler chains, definePage macro, route guards.

islands.title: Islands
islands.desc: Partial hydration via client:load{'|'}idle{'|'}visible{'|'}media{'|'}only, auto-registered and hydrated.

platforms.title: Multi-platform
platforms.desc: Node, Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, Bun, Deno presets with a capability matrix.

devtools.title: DevTools
devtools.desc: Panel with Pages, API, Middleware, Cron, Env, Playground and an AI assistant. Full route inspection and server action debugging.

i18n.title: i18n
i18n.desc: vue-i18n 11 with compact locale routing and SSR hydration.

ecosystem.auth: Email/password and OAuth authentication with session management.
ecosystem.icon: Local SVG icon collections with Iconify API fallback.
ecosystem.content: Markdown collections with frontmatter, TOC and full-text search.
ecosystem.image: Optimized image processing and responsive srcset.
ecosystem.ai: Agent and tool definitions on top of the Vercel AI SDK.
ecosystem.integrations: PWA, fonts, Electron, Pinia and UI integrations.
